facts: Parties: Corrib Energy plc (Buyer), Calloway Media Ltd (Seller); the Company is Upton Holdings Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 30 January 2027; Closing is scheduled for 22 March 2027 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 120 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 30 January 2027), either party may terminate.
Section 3.4 (Earn-out): the Earn-out Payment equals 3 times the amount by which FY2026 EBITDA exceeds $6,500,000, capped at $5,000,000.

Section 9.4 (De Minimis and Basket): the Seller shall not be liable unless the aggregate of all claims exceeds $1,400,000 (1.0% of the Purchase Price), in which case the Seller shall be liable only for the excess over that amount.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 29 June 2027.
Management accounts show FY2026 EBITDA of $7,300,000; the Seller says the Earn-out Payment will therefore be $3,000,000.
